result:
The `store` warning is gone, and typecheck and tests still pass. I'll make the change, then report what I didn't re-verify.

The audit warning on `PostController.store` is fixed. `store` now calls `Post.create(data, { set: { authorId: author.id } })` instead of `forceCreate` with the request data spread in. `authorId` stays out of `fillable` and the body schema, so the request still cannot set it. Typecheck and the existing tests pass.

The audit still reports two dependency advisories, katex (warn) and source-map-js (fail), which are unrelated to this change and were already there; the stop gate passed on them, so I left them alone. I did not re-run the tag create flow end to end after this switch, so it's worth a quick check of store with tags before merging.
